rationale: The measurement system evaluation shows a Gauge R&R study variation of 16.61% and 8 distinct categories, which meet standard industrial thresholds (GR&R < 30%, ndc >= 5) for conditional measurement system acceptability. The evidence thus supports a GO decision for substantive downstream process assessment. The report correctly interprets the MSA results without overclaiming absolute gauge accuracy. It subsequently performs standard, valid analyses of process baseline, capability, applicators, and post-change monitoring, accurately identifying and navigating the lack of causal intervention records.
